props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. The schema is read through it, once per page.

props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: The type the path starts on.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The dotted path. Empty when nothing is chosen.

props.name: on_value_change
props.meaning: Receives the new path, or the empty string on clear.

props.name: deep_links
props.meaning: Allow descending through entity fields.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the programmatic name beside the display name in each row.

props.name: max_depth
props.meaning: How many hops a path may take.

props.name: data_types
props.meaning: Data types a field must have to be selected.

props.name: valid_types
props.meaning: A field is selectable only if it links one of these.

props.name: exclude
props.meaning: Full dotted paths to drop.

props.name: hide_paths
props.meaning: Dotted prefixes to drop, along with everything beneath them.

props.name: filterable_only
props.meaning: Drop the data types the API refuses in a filter.

props.name: extra_fields
props.meaning: Synthetic entries offered at the root only, labelled `computed`.

props.name: filter
props.meaning: Your own visibility test over the schema and the candidate's full path.

props.name: close_on_select
props.meaning: Off keeps the popover open for the next pick.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Shown while nothing is chosen.

props.name: search_placeholder
props.meaning: Shown in the search box.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the search matches nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: clearable
props.meaning: Show the clear control once a field is chosen.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Keeps full contrast and removes the chevron and the clear control.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Applies the invalid ring and `aria-invalid`.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popover is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

events.name: value_changed
events.when: A field is chosen, or the clear control is pressed, which sends the empty string.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The popover opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

keyboard.does: On the closed control, opens it.
Move the cursor through the rows.
Descend into the highlighted field, or pick the highlighted target type.
Go back one level, or cancel the choice of target type.
Choose the highlighted field. On a field that can only be descended into, descends.
In an empty search box, clears the value.
